faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How long until I get access?
faq.a1: We approve access by hand, usually within one working day. You get an email when it's ready — your 14 days start then, not when you apply. No need to sit in front of a waiting screen.
faq.q2: Do I need a card for the trial?
faq.a2: No. The 14-day trial needs no card — just an email and how many active clients you're working with right now.
faq.q3: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
faq.a3: Nothing gets deleted. Your workspace becomes read-only: you can still see your clients and their past programs, and chat stays open — but you can't send new invites or assignments until you subscribe again.
faq.q4: What does my trainer see of my data?
faq.a4: Only what you share as an active client: your workouts, your stats, your weight and your steps — read-only. They don't see your water intake, and they can't edit anything on your behalf.
faq.q5: How do you count an active client?
faq.a5: Every client who accepted your invite and whose access you haven't revoked. Pending (not yet accepted) invites also count toward your seats, so you're never surprised by a full plan.

pricing.title: You pay for how many clients you have
pricing.subtitle: Every feature is in every tier. The difference is the number of active clients.
pricing.finePrint: Prices display in forint or euro depending on your billing country and include VAT. Subscribing carries a 14-day EU withdrawal right; the trial never touches a card because it starts without one. An active client is one with a live relationship — ending it frees up a seat.
pricing.finePrintMobile: Prices in forint or euro depending on your billing country, VAT included. 14-day EU withdrawal right. The trial starts without a card.
pricing.mobileProBody: Ad-free app, full history, AI — subscribe from the app.
pricing.manageNoticeText: If you already have a plan, the CTA on every card becomes “Manage plan”, and your current plan is marked “Your current plan”.
pricing.faqQ1: What happens at the end of the trial?
pricing.faqA1: Your workspace doesn't shut down — it goes into a restricted mode: you still see every client, their data and past programs, but sending new invites, assignments or scheduling needs a subscription. Chat always stays available.
pricing.faqA2: Yes, no reason needed. Cancelling keeps your subscription active through the end of the current billing period; you won't be charged again after that.
pricing.faqQ3: What happens to my clients if I downgrade or cancel?
pricing.faqA3: Nobody is archived automatically. If you have more active clients than your new tier allows, you choose who to archive — everyone else's data and history stays untouched. If you cancel, your clients' sponsored Pro stays active for another 7 days.
pricing.faqQ4: Where do I find my invoice?
pricing.faqA4: Every invoice is issued by Stripe and emailed to you — you can also download it any time from your account's billing history.
pricing.faqA5: Yes, you can move to a bigger or smaller plan any time from your account; the difference is prorated automatically on your next invoice.
pricing.faqA6: Yes, the listed prices include VAT; EU businesses may qualify for reverse charge, which Stripe applies automatically at checkout.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: Lifey is operated by the provider named on the Imprint page (see the Legal menu). Lifey consists of a trainer workspace (a web interface, for trainers) and a connected mobile app (for trainers and their clients). These Terms apply to both.
terms.s2Body: The trainer workspace lets a trainer invite clients, write workout programs, schedule sessions and track client performance. The mobile app is used by a client to log workouts, nutrition, weight and other training-related data. Core app features are free for every user; the paid subscription (Pro tier) unlocks additional features, detailed on the Pricing page.
terms.s3Body: Using the service requires registering with a valid email address. One account belongs to one natural person; sharing an account with a third party is not permitted. By registering, you confirm the information you provide is accurate and that you accept these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
terms.s4Body: Trainer access is granted on approval, typically within one business day; the 14-day free trial starts at the moment of approval, with no card required. When the trial ends, the workspace enters a restricted mode: existing data and messages with clients stay available, but sending a new invite, assignment or schedule requires an active subscription. Subscription tiers and prices are listed on the Pricing page, from a single, always-current source. A subscription stays active through the end of the current billing period after cancellation; no further charge follows.
terms.s5Body: While a client's relationship with a paying trainer is active, the client automatically and free of charge receives Pro-tier features (ad-free app, full history, unlimited AI). For 7 days after the relationship ends or the trainer's subscription lapses, this entitlement stays unchanged, after which it reverts to the client's own individual entitlement.
terms.s6Body: EU consumers' 14-day right of withdrawal is described in detail in the separate Withdrawal Notice — see the Legal menu.
terms.s7Body: The service is provided "as is". The provider makes every reasonable effort to keep the service continuously available but is not liable for indirect damages arising from a temporary outage. Workout programs and nutrition suggestions are not medical or dietetic advice; consult a professional before making health-related decisions.
terms.s8Body: The Lifey name, logo, and the service's design and source code are the provider's intellectual property. Content you upload (e.g. your own training data) remains yours; the provider uses it only to the extent needed to provide the service.
terms.s9Body: The provider may amend these Terms. Material changes are announced by email or an in-app notice, with reasonable notice before they take effect.
terms.s10Body: These Terms are governed by Hungarian law. For questions or complaints, reach the provider via the Contact page or directly by email (see the Imprint page).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: The data controller's details are on the Imprint page. This notice fulfils the information obligation under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.s2Body: At registration: name, email address, password (stored encrypted). Through your own use of the app: workout data, nutrition data, weight, step count, water intake, and — if you allow it — Apple Health / Health Connect data. For trainers, additionally: their client list and messages exchanged with clients. For a paid subscription, billing data is handled by Stripe and not stored by us directly.
privacy.s3Body: Processing serves to provide the service (performance of a contract, GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), account security (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f)) and, for a subscription, billing and tax obligations (legal obligation, Art. 6(1)(c)).
privacy.s4Body: Only a client's active trainer can access their data, and only what the client actively shares: workouts, statistics, weight and step count — read-only. Water intake is never visible to a trainer. A trainer cannot edit any data on a client's behalf.
privacy.s5Body: We retain data until account deletion, or, for an inactive account, until the legally required retention period expires. Deletion can be requested via the Contact page or directly by email; we carry it out irreversibly within a reasonable time of receiving the request.
privacy.s6Body: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing of, port, and object to the processing of your data. To exercise these rights, reach us via the Contact page or directly by email. You may also lodge a complaint with the Hungarian data protection authority (NAIH).
privacy.s7Body: The service relies on the following processors: Stripe (payment, trainer subscriptions), Resend (transactional email), and — in the free, ad-supported tier — Google AdMob (ad delivery, consent-based). None of them uses the data for a purpose independent of Lifey.
privacy.s8Body: This marketing website uses no tracking cookies; visit analytics (Vercel Analytics) run cookieless and anonymous. The app stores only the technically necessary data to keep you signed in — this does not require consent under applicable rules.
privacy.s9Body: Data is transmitted over an encrypted connection (HTTPS); passwords are stored in a form that cannot be reversed. Access within the service is role-based: a trainer can only reach the data of their own active clients.
privacy.s10Body: For questions about data processing, reach us via the Contact page or directly by email (see the Imprint page).

withdrawal.title: Withdrawal Notice
withdrawal.s1Body: Consumers in the European Union have a 14-day, no-reason right of withdrawal when ordering a digital service, under Hungarian Government Decree 45/2014 (II. 26.). The withdrawal period is counted from the day the subscription starts.
withdrawal.s2Body: You can exercise the right of withdrawal via the form on the Contact page, or directly by email (see the Imprint page), with an unambiguous statement (e.g. "I withdraw from my subscription"). The trial starts without a card, so there is nothing to withdraw from during it — the right of withdrawal becomes relevant once a paid subscription starts.
withdrawal.s3Body: If, during checkout, you explicitly request immediate performance and simultaneously acknowledge that doing so forfeits your right of withdrawal once the service has been fully delivered, the right of withdrawal ends when performance is complete — the standard EU rule for digital services. The checkout flow always requests this acknowledgement separately, via its own checkbox.
withdrawal.s4Body: On a valid withdrawal, the provider refunds the already-paid, not-yet-used portion of the fee within 14 days of receiving the statement, using the original payment method (via Stripe). For an app-store purchase (App Store / Google Play), a refund must be requested under Apple's or Google's own rules in effect at the time of purchase — the provider cannot initiate that refund directly.
